name: [UPD]  Cave Diving Experience
desc:
Squeeze through realistic tight caves, mine rare ores, and upgrade your pickaxe in this deep cave diving adventure!

Explore underwater caves, lava zones, and geothermal tunnels. Collect copper, iron, diamond, emerald, mythril and more. Use scuba gear, thermal protection, and enchants to push deeper.

Fully compatible on Mobile, Tablet, PC, Console & VR.

Features:
• Realistic cave crawling & ragdoll physics
• Ore mining + pickaxe progression
• Scuba diving & heat protection
• Unique caves (Atlantis, Diving Bell, Catacombs & more)
• Cave Rescue system

How deep can you go?
